stories.title: Officers fire weapons after responding to knife call in North Buffalo
stories.summary: Developing: A large police presence shut down part of Hertel Avenue in North Buffalo after officers responded to a knife call on the 1700 block of the roadway.

stories.title: Buffalo bars prepare for busy, safe Thanksgiving Eve
stories.summary: Buffalo bars prepare for busy, safe Thanksgiving Eve, emphasizing increased security and safe rides home ahead of a busy holiday weekend

stories.title: Body found in Lancaster prompts police investigation
stories.summary: A death investigation is underway in Lancaster after a body was discovered near Pavement Road and Peppermint Road.

stories.title: Fairgrounds Festival of Lights returns to Hamburg with new attractions
stories.summary: One of Western New York’s favorite holiday traditions is coming back with new displays, expanded attractions, and multiple ways to visit.

stories.title: 20-year-old man dead following car crash at Lewiston-Queenston Bridge
stories.summary: Police say the 20-year-old man was transported to St. Mary's Hospital, where he later died.

stories.title: 17-year-old taken into custody after shots were fired in Niagara Falls
stories.summary: A 17-year-old was arrested in Niagara Falls after a search warrant tied to a Nov. 17 shooting, Niagara Falls Police say.

stories.title: Motorcyclist dies in weekend crash
stories.summary: The crash happened at Sycamore Street and Woltz Avenue just before 2:30pm.

stories.title: Olean man accused of climbing through drive-thru window, stealing ice cream coupons
stories.summary: He wanted fries. Police say he left with ice cream coupons after climbing through a window.

stories.title: Holiday Valley pushes back opening day on the slopes
stories.summary: Holiday Valley pushing back opening. The Ellicottville resort had planned to open Nov. 27. Crews fired up nearly 120 snow guns after temperatures dropped overnight.

stories.title: Buffalo Zoo, Hartman’s Distilling team up on limited-edition bourbon aging in rainforest exhibit
stories.summary: Buffalo Zoo, Hartman’s Distilling team up on limited-edition bourbon aging in rainforest exhibit, humidity in the rainforest habitat provides strong aging conditions

stories.title: Jamestown man arrested, accused of setting porch on fire
stories.summary: A Jamestown man has been charged with arson after he allegedly started a fire on a porch Sunday morning.

stories.title: Woman killed in crash near Tifft Street and Fuhrmann Boulevard
stories.summary: Lackawanna Police officers were able to locate an adult female who was looking for help on the side of Route 5 after she had been in an accident.
